title: French 79 - Hometown
creator: French 79
description: Enjoy the videos and music you love, upload original content, and share it all with friends, family, and the world on YouTube.
note: One of the greatest French electronic music of all time. It's so nostalgic. So inexplicably saddening but with happiness sprinkled in between. Makes me think of all the things I used to do as a kid - my old hobbies and all everything that I've lost over the years.
